balls.text: Low full toss on middle, makes space and drives to long-off's right. Sneaks back for two
Fifty up for Sundar but it'll only be one. Yorker on off from around the wicket, he cleared the front leg and drove to deep cover. Never looked for two
Yorker outside off, jammed to deep third. Two balls for Sundar
Wants to rotate strike, fails. Pitched up on off, driven to the bowler's right. Rasikh nearly stops it, ball finishes just behind

Rashid goes again... can't clear the boundary this time! Went across the ground by pulling the scrambled-seam ball. 132ks. Bat went from slightly down to up, just over the shoulder. Got it a touch too high. Shepherd takes it to the right at deep-backward square

One of them is here! Has a might swipe across his body and sends the ball flying straight. Back-of-hand length ball outside off, Rashid was waiting which was a virtue as he could load up and flat-bat it
Square driven to deep point's right, Washington doesn't keep strike. Takes two with DDP chasing it a few metres. Back of length outside off after the yorkers
Yorker on off, perfect length. 137ks. Defended to the right of the bowler
Pitched up outside off, driven to deep point

Top edge. Will there be confusion? No, Hazlewood keeps the keeper at bay and allows Bhuvi to get to 28 wickets this season! 128ks short ball around fifth stump, seam up. Seemed slow off the pitch but bounced good. Holder was square-on, jumped and looked to drag it across with a pull. Edged it right back, Jitesh ran straight but Hazlewood ran across from short third and took it. Seemed to have made the call early as Jitesh slowed down
Yorker on off, punched to long-off. Not a dissimilar length to the four Holder hit last over
Washy got twos early on, now the fours are flowing. Pulls this from outside off in the big gap at cow corner. Back of length just outside off, very slow off the pitch and low bounce

Yorker missed by very little, Holder still nails it downtown! Got back in the crease, cleared the front leg and drove through the line. Flat over the bowler it goes. Was a 140ks ball on middle and leg
Low full toss down leg at 141ks. Would've been wide had it been left. Washy flicks it to deep-backward square

Down leg, wide called. Jitesh says he heard a sound, signals a review and Patidar does the same later. Two left for RCB. Was a shortish ball down leg that beat the pull. Ball under hi-height. There is a gap between bat and ball on first replay. Ultra-Edge confirms no contact. Review burnt

David and Kohli nearly crash into each other. Kohli ran left from deep midwicket, slid and half-stopped the ball. Couldn't stop it from going to the boundary. David came in from the other side, stopped, and tumbled forward like bowling pins. Was a full ball that was flicked
Forces a pull and beats short fine leg... Deep-backward square is quick, just one. Back of length on leg, bounce on the lower side
Length on middle and off, flicked to deep midwicket
One-handed hook sends the slower one right behind the keeper. One-bounce four. Slower ball down leg, Washy falling across and jumping as he got the bat above his shoulders. Nearly a six
Length on fourth, inside-halfs an attempted off-drive to midwicket
Washy nicking twos again. Flicks the length ball softy to the edge of the ring at square leg. Played soft enough for deep square leg to run in for a while and allow time.
Wide on a length, cut to deep point. Seemed slow again, pace not shown
Pitched up on middle, flicked to deep midwicket
Pitched up outside off, seemed slow. Driven to long-off. 103ks

Tewatia goes and the crowd go up bigtime! 131ks length ball angling in towards fourth stump from around the wicket. The cross-seamer seemed to lose pace off the pitch and bounced a touch low. Tewatia extended his arms and looked to lift it over mid-on with a mostly horizontal bat. Ball hit low on the bat and Patidar ran back to take a rather easy catch. Rasikh is pumped, he's had a great game so far
Yorker on off, jams a flick to long-on
Upper-cut/ramped over the keeper. Waits for the bouncer to go over him, lifted the bat as it pointed behind the keeper. Middled it. That was above off-stump and head-high
Length outside off, shapes to drive through cover. Bat goes a bit wonky and ball runs to long-off
Calls for two again, gets it again. Washy using the pockets of the ground nicely. Stayed still and drove the back of length ball outside off through cover. Point ran left
Jumps and pulls this time, two called, they make it. Short ball outside off, hit from head-height to long-on's left. Right-handed fielder allowing more time
Short ball let go. Washy was side-on, on off stump, jumped and swivelled. Shaped for the pull before letting go
Flicked off the back foot to deep square leg. Top of middle, 139ks. Timeout taken, flood in the comments, folks!
Pulled with limited follow-through, to deep-backward point. Back of length on leg, rose just under shoulder-height
Shortish ball outside off, 139ks, cut late and softly to deep third
Length on off, punched to mid-off's left. Misfield by Patidar allows two
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket

Forget Ben, It's Josh cutting off Arshad's attack. Trademark back-of-length ball skidded and rushed Arshad. He was back in the crease, swivelling for the pull. Ball came under belly-height. He got cramped - upper-body bent down, elbows weren't extended and the top edge went straight to short fine leg.
Slower length ball outside off, driven to cover
Pulls the short ball from fourth stump to deep midwicket. Around neck-high ball

GT pulling something out of nothing here! Smacks it off a length to the left of the sight-screen. Pace on, just outside off; Arshad staying back in the crease, opening his stance a bit and swinging across his knees
Slower back of length ball on leg, flicked to square leg

Nothing intentional here, but four happy runs for Sundar. He looked to drive the rising back of length ball through cover. Had some room and got a thin edge that went through first slip. On second look, he might have wanted to go fine as his head turned back quickly
Short ball pulled in the gap through midwicket. 136ks just under the shoulder, outside off, bat face going down upon impact. Intentionally grounded
Length on leg, flicked to long-on. That's Krunal done for the night with ball.
Touch shorter and quicker, Arshad backs away and inside-halfs a cut to long-on
Boundary drought ended by the new batter, Arshad. Waited for the length ball on off, slugged across the line and held his shape for an 81-metre six over midwicket.
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg

One more? No, doesn't carry to midwicket. Krunal was running in half-celebration, leapt in disappointment as that landed well in front of and to the right of Patidar, who dove across. Length ball on leg, spooned flick

Five-head Krunal outfoxes Buttler! Sees him dance down, so he yorks him wide. 114ks, lands in line with Buttler's back-knee after beating bat. Buttler's upper body froze late as he reached out, trying to scythe the ball away. Too late and Krunal celebrates with intensity. GT's big three toppled!
Back of length, lands around leg and follows the batter as he makes room. Flick beaten, deflects off the thigh towards backward point
Helps it off the pads to deep fine leg
Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket. Slower one but banged short, top-of-stump bounce
Slow off the pitch, a bit of low bounce. Pulls the back of length ball from off stump to deep square leg. 113ks
Makes room and pulls the short ball from leg stump to deep-backward square
Back of length around off, flicked off the leading edge to the bowler's right
Clobbers the length ball from off to long-on. Stayed upright, got it off the inside-half
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Length outside off, driven to cover
Length outside off, punched off the back foot to cover
Length on leg, a bit more air given, leading edged flick goes to the bowler's left
Length on leg, darted, worked back to the bowler. 99ks

Duffy joins the wickets column and GT have lost a fourth.> The short ball does GT one more time. Banged in short on middle and leg, he pulls and gets a big top edge. Jordan Cox runs in from deep fine and completes the catch. Haaaang on... hang on! The third umpire is summoned and it looks like the ball is on ground. Yes, the third umpire says that the fingers are not underneath. What's happened is that as Cox runs forward, dives, his fingers are split and the ball is grassed. Washy, who had almost walked back has to come back .
Aerial but safe. Length ball at 135.8kph on, he chips that to long-on. That ball shows the pitch is a tad on the slower side
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and shovels to deep backward square leg
Back of a length ball outside off, he pushes through covers with a slightly open face of the bat
Hard length ball on his pad, he works this to deep backward square leg
Starts off with a rising back of a length ball on off stump, he punches to mid-off
Bowls this quicker and on leg stump, he gets across and whisks this to deep backward square leg
Quicker on off stump at 103.1kph, he works that to the left of midwicket and wanted the run. Is rightly sent back
Flatter length ball on middle at 102kph, he ticks that to deep midwicket
Darted at 104.1kph on middle stump, he shovels this to deep square leg
A touch slower on a length on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
Flatter length ball on off, he pushes to extra cover

Straight down Padikkal's throat at long-on. Another one bites the dust as Sindhu walks back. Rising back of a length ball on middle at 132kph. He charges down the track but is not in control as he goes for the pull. Also loses his balance in playing that shot with the ball only going as far as DDP who is stationed perfectly.
Good length ball outside off, he pats this to extra cover

Excellent fielding from David saves two. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he pulls in the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg. David sprints to his left from deep midwicket, dives and keeps the ball inside the field of play
Banged in short on off stump, he cue-ends his pull to long-on
Chipped to long-on. Good length ball angling into Sindhu on middle, he gets it to Padikkal
Short and wide outside off stump, he cuts that to deep point for a run. Buttler playing withing himself so far
Solid start for Krunal, conceding just five runs off his first over. Flatter on off stump at 98kph, Sindhu pushes to extra cover
Now he slows this up on a length at 93.2kph on middle and leg, Buttler ticks this to deep midwicket
Pushed through on a length on off stump at 99.7kph, he eases that to long-on
Darted at 99.2kh down leg, he turns this to short fine leg as they hare across for a run
On a length outside off stump, he drives it on the up to deep cover
Starts off with a flatter length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep backward square leg
On a length on off stump, he punches to covers. Powerplay done and dusted
Helped off his hips for four more. Slower back of a length ball down leg, he gets inside the line and sends it to the deep backward square leg region
Misses out. Shin-high full toss outside off stump, he mistimes it off the inside-half of his bat to mid-on and scampers through for a quick run
Short and wide outside off, he frees his arms and thrashes that but only as deep point
Rising good length ball on off stump, he rises with the bounce and pushes to the right of the bowler
Starts off with a length ball on off which is defended to covers
Ooh, banged in short on middle, Buttler belatedly ducks under
Back of a length ball at 144.7kph on off, he turns this to midwicket
Back of a length ball outside off stump, Sindhu steers this to deep backward point
Misfield will fetch Sindhu four more. On a length angling away from Sindhu, he stabs at this with an open face of the bat to Bhuvi at short third. He fumbles and lets the ball through.
Just over cover-point.  A bit of room for Sindhu outside off stump, he frees his arms and crashes it over Kohli, who was well in
Hard length ball on middle stump, he gets right behind it and pushes to mid-off
Buttler is away. Length ball down leg, he nudges that fine and for four to the deep fine leg area
Almost a run out. Length on middle and leg, he flicks to the left of midwicket, who dives and intercepts. Sindhu was almost halfway down for a run and has to scamper back

The bouncer has brought about Sai Sudharsan's downfall.  Banged in short outside off stump, a very well-directed short ball from Bhuvi. Sai Sudharsan has to fetch that 138.6kph delivery from outside off, he gets a top-edge with the ball ballooning to the short fine leg region. Jitesh runs behind it and takes a comfortable catch
Oh, he's charged at him and Bhuvi hasn't taken to it kindly. Bangs this halfway down at 132.8kph and Sai Suds has to sway away from the line of that
Ooh, that's shaped back in! On a length on off stump, Sai Suds pushes that back to the bowler, albeit not in control
A touch back of a length ball on middle, he turns this through square leg for a couple
Rising back of a length ball outside off, he pats this to backward point
Length ball on middle and leg, he clips to deep backward square leg

Oof, so close to another one. Skiddy good length ball that hurries Sai Suds just around off stump. He is late on the pull and almost splices a return catch to Hazlewood, with the ball falling to the right of him
On a length outside off, he pushes to covers and sets off

Straight up, straight up and Gill is out of here. The aggression of Gill goes against him this time around. Back of a length ball outside off, Gill stays inside his crease this time to the 142kph delivery. He looks to go across the line, gets it on the higher part of the bat, with the ball spooning up. Patidar runs to his right from mid-off and takes a good catch
Gill goes after Josh right away. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he charges down the track, gives himself room and pulls with authority to the deep midwicket region
Another probing delivery to end the over. Seam-up length ball just outside off, Sai Suds, to his credit played inside the line of that
Good length ball outside off stump, he jumps down the track and cuts this hard to deep point
Good length ball just outside off, he under-edges to short third
Uff, what a riposte from Gill! Just a touch fuller, swinging back into Gill, he takes a couple of steps down the track and absolutely smokes the cover drive on the up
My word, that is a jaffa! Dead upright seam bowled on a length on off and shaping away from Gill who is beaten left, right and centre
Wobble-seam length ball just outside off, he squirts it off the inside-half of the bat to mid-on
On a length slanting onto Gill's pads, he flicks it away tidily to deep backward square leg for a run
Duffy has been wayward so far this evening. Nerves? Probably. Pushes the length ball down leg, called a wide again
On the fuller side of length just outside off, he opens the face of the bat and punches to deep backward point
Fuller and down leg, called a wide again

Has Sai Suds been strangled down leg? RCB are confident and up goes the umpire's finger.  But Sai Sudharsan has reviewed almost immediately. There was a sound as the ball went past his bat. Anything there? Doesn't look like. Short of a length ball down leg, he looks to hook that and misses. He was quick to go for the review and has been vindicated. Nothing on the UltraEdge Also called a wide.
Oof, that's Sai Suds at his best! Too full just outside off stump, he leans forward and absolutely laces the drive on the up with plenty of style to the right of mid-off
Flicked fine, flicked for four and GT are away. Sliding down leg stump on a length, Sai Sudharsan tucks that tidily to the vacant deep fine leg fence
Again, a hint of nibble back into Sai Suds on off stump. He presents the full face of the bat and drives on the up to mid-off
Good first ball from Duffy! Fuller, swinging in on middle stump, Sai Sudharsan works this to mid-on

Ee salanoo cup namde. Kohli goes back in the crease, opens his stance and smears the length ball over long-on. Points to the stands and shakes his hands in a cupping motion. The players run out for celebrations. Gill looks on with a blank face. Fireworks begin
Pulled wide of mid-on and the scores are level! Back of length over off, pulled into the gap between midwicket and mid-on.
Rabada at deep third is very fine. So it'll be just one. Back of length just outside off, Jitesh, on the back foot, opened up proper as he opened the face and got it wide of the keeper
Low full toss on middle and off. Jitesh was nearly on fourth stump as he flicked to midwicket. Stayed well inside the crease
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third
Length on fourth, run down to deep third with a fully open face. Arshad falls into the ground, likely cramps. Left leg.
Chops the length ball to cover. Overhit that, dribbled to the left and smiled at himself
Wide and fullish, slapped over extra cover with a nice drive. Long-off stops it
Length around top of off, driven back to the bowler
Flicked off the back foot to long-on. Shortish ball on off, legbreak spun. Kohli stayed leg side of the ball and played it nicely. Down to single figures now
Catch is the call, goes safely to long-on. Jitesh went back and pulled the short skiddy ball from outside off. Bounce a touch low
Length on leg, low bounce. Leading edge off the flick goes to cover.

Kohli finally falls? He's asking someone if that's out. Walks back to Jitesh. The umpire, Nitin Menon, seems to signal him to walk. And he does... And he turns again. Third umpire's voice comes on for the first time, he'll check. Gill was forward, on his right knee as he tried to take a low catch. The catch was taken inches above the ground, ball popping down... and the question is did he plonk it like Cox did in the first innings? "I can see the fingers on the side of the ball and some part of the ball touching the ground", Madanagopal says. "Ball is touching the ground between the fingers" and a massive cheer erupts as not out is called. "Told you so" signals Kohli. Fist pump and a c'mon from him, Gill looks down in disappointment. Length ball outside off, driven uppishly on the up. Was dying on Gill at mid-off
Length on off, punched off the back foot to mid-off's right
Length in the channel, defended to cover. Jitesh was back in the crease, just outside off and square on
Trademark cover drive, bit more than a punch. Hit off a length to deep cover
Pulled fine, rolls to the cushion in front of the GT dugout. Short ball from over the wicket at chest-height. Middle stump line. Kohli slightly square on, inside the line and helping it along
Length in the channel, defended to backward point
Beats the upper cut. The toe of Jitesh's bat pointing around short third as he lifted the blade and looked to life the bouncer around fifth

Flicks it over midwicket, softly played though. Lands in the outfield and is stopped by deep square leg. Had to run a fair distance to the left. Length ball on the pads. Kohli struggled through to the second there
Hard length on off, goes square-on and defends to backward point

Extra-cover drive! Not much footwork but covered the line and hit it off a length. Not much bounce there. Jitesh was standing on fourth stump which helped too. Cheers in the crowd as the asking rate slumps to 3.45
Back of length around off, defended towards backward point
Punches the full ball on off to long-on.

That looks out. Arshad convinced and then in disbelief. Buttler threw the ball up. Quick sign to review from GT. 144ks length ball landed on leg and finished on middle and off. David was in the crease, front leg slightly away as he looked to defend straight. The ball took a feather while angling away, Ultra-Edge confirms. Ball still seaming, Sid Monga says. David gets a pat on the shoulder from Kohli
Square driven to point. Touch uppish, lands well within the fielder. Length ball angling away towards off, David showed all stumps and flashed
Boundary-per-over trend continues. David jumps and makes a bit of room as he cuts the short ball from outside off over cover
Gawd! That's a Test ball met with a Test shot. Fullish length ball around off, punched with the straightest of bats. Long-off goes right and stops it
Length on leg, flicked to short midwicket's right. Kohli took a quarter of a run and headed back. More of a jog again
Length in the channel, square driven to deep point. Kohli walks the run
Googly. Length on middle at 91ks. Pulled with the spin to deep midwicket. Final timeout of the season
Goes back and flicks it from middle stump to deep square leg. Kohli hobbling through the run, he's chatting to himself and has a word and a smile with Rashid
Goes back and drives it to long-on
Over Rabada at long-on! David does what Patidar couldn't! Touch short outside off, pulled off the lower-third of the bat. Went flat and teased the fielder before clearing him
Pitched up on off, defended to the bowler's left
Spooned... wide of Rashid! He ran and then dove to the left but was nowhere within reach. Ball rolled to long-off. Length ball it was around off, Kohli defended off the back foot. Hit high on the bat
Tap and run towards backward point, who remained well inside. Couldn't stop the single though. Hard length ball around off, defended off the back foot
Length in the channel, stabs it with a vertical bat to backward point
Cut over the infield again, goes to deep point. Wide on a length, David reaches out with his hands
Very wide on a length, Kohli reaches out with the upper-body and top-edges a cut outside the ring. Deep third stops it to the right
Fastest fifty in the IPL for Kohli! He raises his bat high and turns around. Looks stoic as ever. Was a short ball outside off at 141ks, dragged across over wide mid-on with a pull
Length on off, defended towards backward point, who's in close
Edge... flies in the gap! David stays back in the crease and cuts it off a thickish edge. Ball goes well to the left of short third. No chance for slip either. Placement and luck favouring David
David has time to wait for the googly. He backs away and cuts the length ball on middle to backward point. Looked like he tried to read that off the pitch
Good stop by Arshad at sweeper cover. Ran right and dove smartly to pull the ball in. That ball had width and bounce for the cut
Googly nearly crashes through the gate! Fullish length ball around off, David stood around leg stump and looked to drive it through cover, bat mostly diagonal. Edges it onto pad
Goes back and flicks the length ball on middle to deep-backward square. 91ks

Direct hit from the deep. Rashid jumps back as the ball bounces and hits the stumps low. "Safe, safe, safe, goes the third umpire. Ball was shortish outside off, slapped towards deep cover. Sent back upstairs again for some reason, J Madanagopal confirms that David slid the ball past the crease when ball hit stumps. Arshad the fielder
Short outside off, left on length. David swayed back
Nails this pull wide of long-on. Kohli's pumped. Shortish ball outside off from wide of the crease, pulled from stomach-height and brings up RCB's hundred
Cloths it to mid-off. Hard length ball in the channel, David pulls with an open-stance. Hurried. Ball goes off the splice to mid-off. Along the ground
Short ball around shoulder-height. 134ks. Pulled to deep midwicket. Fun and games as Kohli turns for two and asks Rashid to throw. He smiles and throws to keeper
Length on off, defends to the right of the pitch and looks to take off. Loud call of no from David
Pressure-release ball. Down leg, on a length at 133ks. Glanced from within the crease, gets it fine. No deep fine leg
Reaches forward and pushes the length ball on fourth through cover

And Rashid has brought it back to life! Krunal has a chat with Kohli but doesn't review! Loopy full ball on off, Krunal moves across to off, clears the front leg out of the way and goes for a hard sweep. The legbreak spins in a touch to beat bat and hit the back leg in front of off. Krunal swipes his bat in frustration on the way back, Rashid and co celebrate. Hawk-Eye shows that'd have smashed middle and off
Short ball. Pulled well, finds deep-backward square. Should've been four that. Long-hop spinning into leg, Kohli got square-on and muscled it along the ground
Full on off, punched to long-off

Rabada takes soft steps back... and takes the catch on the long-on boundary! He raised his right leg upon taking it but the back leg was still after he took it above head. Spin-hitter Patidar saw a full ball, got on one knee and swept it from outside off. Got a lot of height on it, nearly got it over. Rashid strikes second ball
WIde and full, reaches out and slashes to long-on
Pulled with disdain! Back of a length ball outside off, he stays deep in the crease and on off stump and pulls magnificently to the right of long-on.
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts to backward point
Length ball on middle and leg, he ticks this to the left of Rabada at midwicket who misfields but long-on was alert and ran in quickly
On a length around off stump, he pushes to extra cover
Hard length ball on off stump, he gets across and works this to the right of midwicket for a run
On a length decking back into Kohli on middle and leg, he ticks this to deep backward square leg
On a length on off, he works this to midwicket. Siraj has bowled out; 4-0-36-1
Bouncer but that is too high on off, Patidar has nothing to do with that
Length ball on middle and leg, he whips this to the right of mid-on for a couple of runs
On the fuller side of length, he presents the full face of the bat and eases to long-on
On a length on off stump, he punches to long-on
Length ball on middle and leg, he flicks to midwicket
Patidar has waited four balls, his fifth goes for six! Banged in short on off, he swivels and pulls and sends it soaring for an 80m six over deep square leg
Wickets, no wickets... Kohli is going after Rabada! Short ball outside off stump, Kohli pulls, gets a top edge but with no deep fine leg in place that has flown over the boundary. Kohli is 35 off 12!
Length ball on his hips, he ticks this behind square on the leg side to get off the mark
Banged in short on off, he sways outside the line of that
On a length on off stump, he prods half-forward and defends to cover
Full outside off stump, Patidar pushes at it without moving his feet and gets beaten

CARVED to deep third! That is wicket No. 29 for Rabada which wins him the purple cap. He gives himself room but Rabada bowls this fullish and outside off. Padikkal has to reach for it, and he ends up slicing it to the left of Arshad, who runs to his left and takes a smart catch
Length ball angling away from DDP outside off, he steers this fine to deep third
On a length on off stump, he plays with an open face of the bat to point
Length ball on middle and leg, he pushes back towards the bowler

Straight to mid-on but Venky Iyer has done his job! Siraj cramps the batter for room who was once again backing away. He goes deep in the crease but Siraj rushes him for pace with the good length ball at 147.5kph on leg. He mistimes to Rabada who makes no mistake

CLEARS the boundary one more time! Banged in short on leg stump, Venky Iyer swivels and pulls with power. He gets a bit of a top-edge and the ball clears Sai Sudharsan who runs to his left but can't reach it despite the dive
Backs away but Siraj follows Kohli with the good length ball. He adjusts and helps it to deep midwicket
Banged in short again outside leg as Venky Iyer backs away to pull that. He gets a bit of a top-edge with the ball lobbing towards the wickets
Just a run! That's like an event with the way RCB are going. Banged in short on leg, he pulls, this time to deep square leg
BANG! The ball is pinging off Kohli's blade. Banged in short on middle, he absolutely nails the pull to the deep midwicket fence

VIRAT KOHLI STOP THAT! A flick of the wrists and my word, he's tonked that! That was bowled at 155kph, and Kohli has deposited that over deep midwicket as he was playing a spinner. A no look six from the KING! Length on off and middle, he sends that soaring over deep midwicket
TWO IN TWO! On a length on middle, all wrists at work as he shovels through square leg
WHIPPED for four more! This is getting one-sided too quickly. Full on leg stump, he flicks it to the deep backward square leg fence
Tries again and gets beaten. Siraj has a few words to say to him. Bouncer angling away from Iyer outside off. He looks for a pull and for once, fails to connect
BAM! Not off the middle of the bat but the runs count. Banged in short on middle and off. He pulls off the lower part of the bat and the ball trickles into the deep square leg fence
A quick single and they make it. On a length around off stump, he pushes towards mid-on and sets off. Venkatesh hobbles and makes it
Pulled through square leg! Back of a length ball just around off, he gets it to the right of midwicket and the ball flies away
An ungainly slog from Kohli and he gets beaten. On a length on middle and leg, he charges down and looks to slam it across the line. Gets beaten on the inside-edge
Kohli into the act now! Siraj goes inswinger but the line is too straight. On middle and leg, he gets across and flicks imperiously to the right of deep backward square leg

Rabada is bleeding runs and Venky Iyer is cashing in! 18 off that over. On a length outside off, he throws his hands at it, gets a thick outside edge which goes over the 'keeper's head for four. They all count
Beaten again! Good length ball with a hint of shape away from Venky Iyer. He looks to go over mid-off but gets beaten
Beware the wounded batter! On a length on middle nibbing back into the batter, he backs away and thumps it to the left of mid-off. He is in pain, but is doing the job
BANG! Length ball on his pad, he whips that with some authority and smashes it miles over deep midwicket
Play and a miss! Rising back of a length ball outside off, he looks to steer that fine and gets beaten
Backs away and carves this over point. On a length outside off, he backs away and charges down and gets this to the deep point fence
Length ball on his pads, he flicks to deep backward square leg for a run
Full on leg stump, he whisks that off the inside half of the bat to the left of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
On the fuller side of length on middle and leg, he looks to flick that away and is rapped on the thigh pad. Siraj has a few words to say to him
How's that missed the leg stump!? Fuller on leg stump, Iyer gets right across eyeing the scoop. The ball moves late and juuuuuust past leg stump as Venky Iyer misses
Length ball on middle and leg, raps him on the thigh pad to the on-side
Siraj is on the money first up. A hint of movement back into Iyer on middle, he pushes this back over the bowler's head for a run
